LinkGraph records route/import/provider/environment/replay/guest/unresolved dependencies and blockers.

Assembly installs the explicit Fabric plans through Runspace APIs only, and preflights residual environment/supervision/admission/guest/handoff metadata without executing handlers during linking.

Boundary owns normalized semantics; Capsule only serializes World execution state and provenance.
Runspace owns execution timelines and mailbox state; Capsule images are deterministic snapshots without native execution capabilities.
Fabric owns explicit causality; Capsule captures and restores only witnessed routes/invocations/receipts.
Linker owns closed-world route synthesis; Capsule verifies embedded LinkCertificate or relinks locally and compares.
Receiver policy owns restore authority; sender permits are inspected as evidence, never trusted as authority.
Capsule restore is transactional; restore denial must happen before any Runspace mutation.
Capsule v1 is fail-closed for unsupported running state, unsafe active Fabric, missing witnesses, relink mismatch, environment mismatch, and permit denial.
Caller supplies a Runspace and optionally an Assembly or RunHandle.
Capsule computes a `QuiescenceReport` over run slots, mailbox state, active Fabric routes, receipts, replay cursors, and transaction blockers.

Freeze rejects non-quiescent state under policy, then gathers RunspaceImage, RunSlotImage, MailboxImage, FabricImage, LinkImage, admission/environment/supervision/guest refs, transcripts, run images, value images, dependencies, manifest, and certificate.

Image encoding uses deterministic section order, explicit versions, length-prefixed byte sections, section fingerprints, dependency refs, and no native pointers/tokens/handlers/credentials/ABI host data.

Receiver validates the image, plans thaw against local registry/catalog/environment/permit policy, verifies or relinks Linker provenance, preflights residual environment requirements, and issues a receiver permit if required.
RestoreTransaction stages handle remaps, mailbox remaps, Fabric invocation remaps, guest conformance checks, replay/verify setup, and all blockers before mutating the destination Runspace.

Commit restores supported run images, parked/completed/failed slots, pending mailbox entries, completed receipts, active parked Fabric invocations, timeline/provenance refs, and restore receipt references.
Resume/replay/verify proceeds through existing Runspace, Fabric, Handoff, Admission, Supervision, Guest, Timeline, and Machine surfaces only.

Boundary owns normalized semantics; Capsule only serializes World execution state and provenance.
Runspace owns execution timelines and mailbox state; Capsule images are deterministic snapshots without native execution capabilities.
Fabric owns explicit causality; Capsule captures and restores only witnessed routes/invocations/receipts.
Linker owns closed-world route synthesis; Capsule verifies embedded LinkCertificate or relinks locally and compares.
Receiver policy owns restore authority; sender permits are inspected as evidence, never trusted as authority.
Capsule restore is transactional; restore denial must happen before any Runspace mutation.
Capsule v1 is fail-closed for unsupported running state, unsafe active Fabric, missing witnesses, relink mismatch, environment mismatch, and permit denial.
Caller supplies a Runspace and optionally an Assembly or RunHandle.
Capsule computes a `QuiescenceReport` over run slots, mailbox state, active Fabric routes, receipts, replay cursors, and transaction blockers.

Freeze rejects non-quiescent state under policy, then gathers RunspaceImage, RunSlotImage, MailboxImage, FabricImage, LinkImage, admission/environment/supervision/guest refs, transcripts, run images, value images, dependencies, manifest, and certificate.

Image encoding uses deterministic section order, explicit versions, length-prefixed byte sections, section fingerprints, dependency refs, and no native pointers/tokens/handlers/credentials/ABI host data.

Receiver validates the image, plans thaw against local registry/catalog/environment/permit policy, verifies or relinks Linker provenance, preflights residual environment requirements, and issues a receiver permit if required.
RestoreTransaction stages handle remaps, mailbox remaps, Fabric invocation remaps, guest conformance checks, replay/verify setup, and all blockers before mutating the destination Runspace.

Commit restores supported run images, parked/completed/failed slots, pending mailbox entries, completed receipts, active parked Fabric invocations, timeline/provenance refs, and restore receipt references.
Resume/replay/verify proceeds through existing Runspace, Fabric, Handoff, Admission, Supervision, Guest, Timeline, and Machine surfaces only.
